meaning: A critical system process has terminated.
fix: Run sfc /scannow. If persistent, check for driver updates or recent hardware changes.

meaning: A severe memory management error occurred.
fix: Run MemTest86 or Windows Memory Diagnostic. Reseat RAM sticks and check for BIOS updates.

meaning: Driver tried to access an address it didn't have permission for.
fix: Standard driver update. Disable any CPU/RAM overclocking. Run DDU for GPU drivers.

meaning: Hardware error detected via Windows Hardware Error Architecture.
fix: Check thermals. Verify drive health with CrystalDiskInfo. If undervolting, revert to stock.

meaning: Store component caught an unexpected exception.
fix: Check disk for errors using chkdsk. Run DISM restorehealth. Check SSD SATA/NVMe connection.

meaning: DPC watchdog timer was triggered due to a long-running DPC.
fix: Update SSD firmware. Update SATA AHCI controller driver in Device Manager.
Update display drivers. Perform clean boot to identify conflicting software.

meaning: Requested data was not found in memory.
fix: Check RAM. Set 'Automatically manage paging file size' in System Properties.

meaning: Windows lost access to the system partition during startup.
fix: Check BIOS storage settings. Run Startup Repair from Windows Recovery.

meaning: Kernel-mode program generated an exception which the error handler didn't catch.
fix: Disable recently installed drivers. Check for BIOS updates. Run sfc /scannow.

meaning: Video card was not responding and Windows restarted the driver.
fix: Reinstall GPU drivers using DDU. Check GPU temperatures and clock speeds.

meaning: Driver is in an inconsistent or invalid power state.
fix: Disable Fast Startup. Update chipset and BIOS drivers. Set Power Plan to High Performance.

meaning: Kernel detected corruption of a critical data structure.
fix: Run Windows Memory Diagnostic. Full malware scan. Run sfc /scannow.

meaning: Kernel detected critical kernel code or data corruption.
fix: Check for driver updates. Run MemTest86 for at least 4 passes.

meaning: Device driver is spinning in an infinite loop.
fix: Update video driver. Check for BIOS update for the motherboard.
Uninstall recently added antivirus. Update all system drivers.
